blocks.text: in / at / on: bitta `-da` ortidagi uch xil tasavvur

O'zbekchada «qayerda?» savoliga deyarli doim `-da` bilan javob beramiz: xona**da**, bekat**da**, devor**da**. Aniqlik kerak bo'lsa, ko'makchi qo'shamiz: tortma **ichida**, eshik **oldida**, stol **ustida**. Ingliz tilida esa ko'makchining ishini predlogning o'zi bajaradi va uni **har safar** tanlash kerak. Asosiy mantiq qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 106-dars): **in** — chegarali hajm yoki hudud **ichida**, **at** — **nuqtada** (to'xtash, uchrashish, biror ish qilish joyi), **on** — **sirtga** tegib. Bu darsda shu mantiqni nozik holatlarga qo'llaymiz: stol va kreslo, burchak, old va orqa tomon, deraza va eshik.

rows: hajm yoki chegarali hudud: tortma, hovuz, maydon, shahar
nuqta: bekat, svetofor, qabulxona, ish stoli
U yerda to'xtaymanmi, kutamanmi, biror ish qilamanmi?
sirt: devor, shift, yorliq, barmoq, orol

blocks.text: **in** uch o'lchamli joylar bilan (in the drawer, in my pocket, in the fridge) va **chegarasi** bor tekis hududlar bilan ishlatiladi: in the garden, in a field, in the square, in the city centre. Suyuqlik va modda ham «idish»: **in** the water, sugar **in** my tea, a hair **in** the soup. British English da **in the street** (ko'chada) deyiladi; on the street amerikachaga yaqin yoki «uysiz, ko'chada yashaydigan» ma'nosida. Mebelda ham shu mantiq: kreslo odamni o'rab oladi — **in** an armchair, oddiy stul va divan esa sirt — **on** a chair, **on** the sofa. Xuddi shunday: **on** the grass (maysa ustida), lekin **in** the long grass (baland o't orasida).

items.text: The keys are **in the left pocket** of my jacket.
There's far too much sugar **in this tea**.
Grandpa likes to doze **in his armchair**, not **on the sofa**.

blocks.text: at — to'xtash, uchrashish va biror ish qilish nuqtasi

**at** joyning shakliga emas, u yerdagi **vaziyatga** qaraydi: biz u yerda to'xtaymiz, kutamiz, uchrashamiz: at the traffic lights, at the roundabout, at the crossroads, at reception, at the checkout, at gate 12. Mebel va asboblar bilan **at** ularni **ishlatayotganimizni** bildiradi: **at** the desk (ishlayapti), **at** the computer, **at** the piano (chalyapti), **at** the wheel (mashina haydayapti), **at** the sink, **at** the table (ovqatlanyapti). Bir narsaning o'zi bilan uch predlog uch xil ma'no beradi:

items.text: Bekzod is **at his desk**, but he's busy on the phone.
Turn right **at the second set of traffic lights**.
Who was **at the wheel** when the accident happened?

blocks.text: on — har qanday sirt: tik, egri va hatto pastki

**on** uchun sirtning gorizontal bo'lishi shart emas: rasm **on** the wall (tik), chiroq **on** the ceiling (pastki sirt), yozuv **on** the label, uzuk **on** her finger, tabassum **on** his face, dog' **on** my shirt. Orol ham quruqlikning «sirti»: **on** an island («in an island» emas). Muhim farq: biror narsa sirtga **tegib** tursa — **on**, materialning **ichida** bo'lsa (teshik, yoriq) — **in**: a picture **on** the wall, lekin a crack **in** the wall; a stain **on** my shirt, lekin a hole **in** my sock.

items.text: There's a hole **in my sock** and a stain **on my shirt** — what a morning!
The price sticker is **on the bottom** of the vase.
Kate lives **on a Greek island** with her husband and two dogs.
items.translation: Keyt eri va ikki iti bilan **Gretsiya orolida** yashaydi.

blocks.text: Bu yerda predlog joyning **ichkarisi** yoki **tashqarisi** haqida gapirayotganimizni ko'rsatadi. Xona, quti, sahifa burchagi — ichki burchak: **in** the corner. Ko'chalar kesishgan joy — tashqi burchak, nuqta: **at** the corner yoki **on** the corner. Old va orqa tomon bilan uch xil holat bor: mashina ichidagi o'rindiqlar — **in** the front / **in** the back; bino, navbat, sinf yoki zalning qismi — **at** the front / **at** the back; yassi narsaning sirti — **on** the front / **on** the back.

rows: xona, quti yoki sahifa ichidagi burchak
**at** the front / back (of a building, queue, class)
katta joy yoki guruhning old / orqa qismi
old qismida / orqa qismida, navbat oxirida
**on** the front / back (of an envelope, a T-shirt)

blocks.text: Ba'zi so'zlar bilan uchala predlog ham ishlatiladi, chunki biz bir joyning turli qismlari haqida gapiramiz. **Deraza**: **at** the window — deraza oldida turibdi; **in** the window — do'kon vitrinasida; **on** the window — oynaga yopishtirilgan. **Eshik**: **at** the door — eshik oldida (kimdir keldi); **on** the door — eshikka osilgan yozuv; **in** the doorway — ostonada. **Suv**: **in** the water — suv ichida (suzuvchi); **on** the water — suv ustida (qayiq, oqqush). O'zbekchada bu farqlar ko'makchi bilan beriladi, shuning uchun tarjimada «oldida», «ustida», «ichida» so'zlari yordam beradi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He's sitting in his desk» → **at his desk**; «on the corner of the room» → **in the corner**; «in the corner of the street» → **at / on the corner**; «I sat on the armchair» → **in the armchair** (lekin **on** the sofa, **on** a chair); «a crack on the wall» → **in the wall** (rasm esa **on** the wall); «Write it in the back of the envelope» → **on the back**; «in an island» → **on an island**; «I'm waiting in the traffic lights» → **at the traffic lights**.

Tanlashdan oldin o'zbekcha ko'makchini qo'shib ko'ring: «**ichida**» mos kelsa — **in**; «**oldida / yonida**» yoki «u yerda biror ish qilyapti» — **at**; «**ustida / sirtida / osilgan**» — **on**. Teshik va yoriq doim «ichida» — **in**.

Bog'lanish: in bed, on the train, on the left, at the top, in the picture — 124-dars; binolar va shaharlar (at the station / in the station, at / in + shahar) — 125-dars; harakat (to, into) — 126-dars; under, behind, opposite — qizil kitob, 109-dars.

**on** the ceiling, **on** the label, **on** an island

**on** a chair, **on** the sofa, **on** the grass
**in** the front / back of a car
**at** the front / back of a queue

**in** the window (vitrinada), a crack **in** the wall

examples.title: **in**: inside a space — a drawer, a pool, a square
examples.description: in — chegarasi bor hajm yoki hudud ichida: tortma, hovuz, maydon, shahar markazi, dala, ko'cha (British English: in the street), kreslo, baland o't.

sentences.text: Your passport is **in the top drawer**, under the bank statements.
sentences.translation: Pasporting **yuqori tortmada**, bank ko'chirmalarining tagida.

sentences.text: The children are swimming **in the pool**, so someone has to keep an eye on them.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **hovuzda** suzishyapti, shuning uchun kimdir ularga qarab turishi kerak.

sentences.text: There's a hair **in my soup**! Could you bring me another bowl, please?
sentences.translation: **Sho'rvamda** soch bor! Iltimos, boshqa kosa olib kela olasizmi?

sentences.text: Hundreds of people were dancing **in the square** in front of the Registan.
sentences.translation: Registon oldidagi **maydonda** yuzlab odamlar raqs tushayotgan edi.

sentences.text: Rents **in the city centre** are much higher than in the suburbs.
sentences.translation: **Shahar markazida** ijara haqi chekka mahallalarga qaraganda ancha baland.

sentences.text: When I was a child, we played football **in the street** until it got dark.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda qorong'i tushguncha **ko'chada** futbol o'ynardik.

sentences.text: Is there any milk left **in the fridge**, or should I buy some on the way home?
sentences.translation: **Muzlatgichda** sut qoldimi yoki uyga qaytayotib olib kelaymi?

sentences.text: Sheep were grazing **in the field** next to the road to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona yo'li yonidagi **dalada** qo'ylar o'tlab yurardi.

sentences.text: Kate lost one of her earrings somewhere **in the long grass** behind the house.
sentences.translation: Keyt sirg'alaridan birini uy orqasidagi **baland o't orasida** qayerdadir yo'qotib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Grandma was sitting **in her favourite armchair**, knitting a scarf for me.
sentences.translation: Buvim **sevimli kreslosida** o'tirib, menga sharf to'qiyotgan edi.

examples.title: **at**: points where we stop, wait or meet
examples.description: at — joy nuqta sifatida: to'xtaydigan, kutadigan yoki uchrashadigan joy — at the roundabout, at reception, at the traffic lights, at the checkout, at gate 12.

sentences.text: Turn left **at the roundabout**, and you'll see the hospital on your right.
sentences.translation: **Aylanma yo'lda** chapga buriling, o'ng tomonda shifoxonani ko'rasiz.

sentences.text: Guests should hand in their room keys **at reception** before eleven on the day they leave.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar jo'nab ketish kuni soat o'n birgacha xona kalitlarini **qabulxonada** topshirishi kerak.

sentences.text: We waited **at the traffic lights** for ages because one of them was broken.
sentences.translation: **Svetoforda** uzoq kutdik, chunki ulardan biri buzilgan edi.

sentences.text: A long queue had formed **at the checkout**, so I used the self-service till.
sentences.translation: **Kassada** uzun navbat hosil bo'lgan edi, shuning uchun o'zim to'lanadigan kassadan foydalandim.

sentences.text: I'll meet you **at the main gate** of the park at six.
sentences.translation: Siz bilan soat oltida bog'ning **asosiy darvozasi oldida** uchrashaman.

sentences.text: The taxi stopped **at the crossroads**, and the driver asked us which way to go.
sentences.translation: Taksi **chorrahada** to'xtadi va haydovchi qaysi tomonga yurishni so'radi.

sentences.text: Who's that man standing **at the bus stop** with a huge suitcase?
sentences.translation: Katta chamadon bilan **bekatda** turgan anovi odam kim?

sentences.text: Passengers for Istanbul are now boarding **at gate 12**.
sentences.translation: Istanbulga uchuvchi yo'lovchilar hozir **12-chiqish eshigida** samolyotga chiqishmoqda.

sentences.text: Dilnoza, there's a courier **at the door** with a parcel for you.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, **eshik oldida** senga posilka olib kelgan kuryer turibdi.

sentences.text: We stopped for petrol **at a service station** halfway between Tashkent and Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Toshkent bilan Samarqand o'rtasidagi **yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchasida** benzin olish uchun to'xtadik.

examples.title: **at** the desk, **at** the wheel: using something
examples.description: at + mebel yoki asbob — uni ishlatayotganda: at the desk, at the computer, at the wheel, at the piano, at the sink. on the desk — ustida (narsa), in the desk — tortmada.

sentences.text: Jasur spends nine hours a day **at his desk** and then wonders why his back hurts.
sentences.translation: Jasur kuniga to'qqiz soat **ish stolida** o'tiradi, keyin esa nega beli og'riyotganiga hayron bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The bus driver fell asleep **at the wheel**, but luckily nobody was hurt.
sentences.translation: Avtobus haydovchisi **rul ortida** uxlab qoldi, lekin baxtiga hech kim jarohatlanmadi.

sentences.text: My little sister sits **at the piano** for two hours every evening before her exam.
sentences.translation: Singlim imtihonidan oldin har kech ikki soat **pianino oldida** o'tiradi.

sentences.text: Grandpa was standing **at the sink**, washing the dishes after dinner.
sentences.translation: Bobom kechki ovqatdan keyin **rakovina oldida** turib idish yuvayotgan edi.

sentences.text: We were all sitting **at the table** when the lights suddenly went out.
sentences.translation: Hammamiz **dasturxon atrofida** o'tirgan edik, to'satdan chiroqlar o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: Don't leave your coffee **on the desk** next to the keyboard — you'll spill it.
sentences.translation: Qahvangni klaviatura yonida **stol ustida** qoldirma — to'kib yuborasan.

sentences.text: The signed contract is **in my desk**, in the second drawer on the left.
sentences.translation: Imzolangan shartnoma **stolimning ichida**, chapdagi ikkinchi tortmada.

sentences.text: Is anyone sitting **at this computer**, or can I use it for a few minutes?
sentences.translation: Bu **kompyuterda** kimdir o'tiribdimi yoki bir necha daqiqa foydalansam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: There was a friendly young woman **at the information desk** who helped us.
sentences.translation: **Ma'lumot stoykasida** bizga yordam bergan samimiy bir yosh ayol bor edi.

sentences.text: Emma has been **at her laptop** since breakfast, trying to finish her dissertation.
sentences.translation: Emma dissertatsiyasini tugatishga urinib, nonushtadan beri **noutbuki oldida** o'tiribdi.

examples.title: **on**: any surface — ceilings, labels, islands
examples.description: on — har qanday sirtga tegib turish: shift (pastki sirt), yorliq, muqova, bilak, barmoq, yuz, orol. Teshik va yoriq materialning ichida — in.

sentences.text: There's a huge spider **on the ceiling** above your bed!
sentences.translation: Karavotingiz tepasidagi **shiftda** katta o'rgimchak bor!

sentences.text: Read the instructions **on the label** before you give the medicine to a child.
sentences.translation: Bolaga dori berishdan oldin **yorliqdagi** ko'rsatmalarni o'qing.

sentences.text: Bekzod has a small tattoo **on his wrist** that nobody at work has noticed.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning **bilagida** kichkina tatuirovka bor, uni ishda hech kim payqamagan.

sentences.text: Look at the photo **on the cover** of this magazine — isn't that your cousin?
sentences.translation: Bu jurnal **muqovasidagi** suratga qara — bu sening amakivachchang emasmi?

sentences.text: They spent their honeymoon **on a tiny island** in the Maldives.
sentences.translation: Ular asal oyini Maldiv orollaridagi **kichkina bir orolda** o'tkazishdi.

sentences.text: The engagement ring **on her finger** cost more than my car.
sentences.translation: Uning **barmog'idagi** unashtiruv uzugi mening mashinamdan qimmatroq turadi.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, there's a big coffee stain **on the sleeve** of my new shirt.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, yangi ko'ylagimning **yengida** kattakon qahva dog'i bor.

sentences.text: You can't hang that heavy mirror **on this wall** because it's too thin.
sentences.translation: U og'ir oynani **bu devorga** osib bo'lmaydi, chunki devor juda yupqa.

sentences.text: A crack has appeared **in the wall** of the old madrasa after the earthquake.
sentences.translation: Zilziladan keyin eski madrasaning **devorida** yoriq paydo bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Why do you always have a smile **on your face**, even on Mondays?
sentences.translation: Nega **yuzingda** doim tabassum bor, hatto dushanba kunlari ham?

examples.title: **in the corner**, **at the corner**, **on the corner**
examples.description: in the corner — xona, quti yoki sahifa ichidagi burchakda; at / on the corner — ikki ko'cha kesishgan tashqi burchakda, ya'ni muyulishda.

sentences.text: There's an old wooden wardrobe **in the corner** of the bedroom.
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonaning **burchagida** eski yog'och shkaf turibdi.

sentences.text: The bakery **on the corner** sells the best non in our neighbourhood.
sentences.translation: **Muyulishdagi** nonvoyxona mahallamizdagi eng mazali nonni sotadi.

sentences.text: Let's meet **at the corner** of Navoi Street and Amir Temur Avenue.
sentences.translation: Navoiy ko'chasi bilan Amir Temur shoh ko'chasi **kesishgan joyda** uchrashaylik.

sentences.text: The teacher made the naughty boy stand **in the corner** for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi sho'x bolani o'n daqiqa **burchakda** turg'izib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: A group of teenagers was hanging around **on the street corner**, laughing loudly.
sentences.translation: Bir guruh o'smirlar **ko'cha muyulishida** baland ovozda kulib, sanqib yurishardi.

sentences.text: Write the date **in the top right-hand corner** of the page.
sentences.translation: Sanani sahifaning **yuqori o'ng burchagiga** yozing.

sentences.text: Is there a cashpoint **on the corner** by the metro station?
sentences.translation: Metro bekati yonidagi **muyulishda** bankomat bormi?

sentences.text: The cat always sleeps **in the corner** of the sofa, where it's warmest.
sentences.translation: Mushuk doim divanning eng iliq joyi — **burchagida** uxlaydi.

sentences.text: Oliver's flat is in the building **on the corner**, above the chemist's.
sentences.translation: Oliverning kvartirasi **muyulishdagi** binoda, dorixonaning tepasida.

sentences.text: A small table with a lamp stood **in the far corner** of the hotel lobby.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona vestibyulining **eng chekka burchagida** chiroqli kichkina stol turardi.

examples.title: Front and back: **in**, **at** or **on**?
examples.description: in the front / back — mashina ichidagi o'rindiqlarda; at the front / back — bino, navbat, sinf, avtobusning old yoki orqa qismida; on the front / back — konvert, futbolka, kitob sirtida.

sentences.text: Children under twelve must sit **in the back** of the car.
sentences.translation: O'n ikki yoshgacha bolalar mashinaning **orqa o'rindig'ida** o'tirishi shart.

sentences.text: I always sit **at the front** of the class, so I can see the board clearly.
sentences.translation: Doskani aniq ko'rish uchun doim sinfning **old qismida** o'tiraman.

sentences.text: Please write your name and address **on the back** of the envelope.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ismingiz va manzilingizni konvertning **orqa tomoniga** yozing.

sentences.text: Madina was sitting **in the front** next to the driver, so she could see the road.
sentences.translation: Madina haydovchi yonida, **oldingi o'rindiqda** o'tirgan edi, shuning uchun yo'lni ko'ra olardi.

sentences.text: The quiet room is **at the back** of the library, behind the computers.
sentences.translation: Sokin xona kutubxonaning **orqa qismida**, kompyuterlar ortida.

sentences.text: There's a picture of the Registan **on the front** of the guidebook.
sentences.translation: Yo'lko'rsatkich kitobning **old tomonida** Registon surati bor.

sentences.text: We were **at the back** of the queue, so we didn't get any tickets.
sentences.translation: Biz navbatning **oxirida** edik, shuning uchun chipta ololmadik.

sentences.text: In the school photo, the tallest boys always stand **at the back**.
sentences.translation: Maktab suratida eng baland bo'yli o'g'il bolalar doim **orqa qatorda** turishadi.

sentences.text: The team's logo is printed **on the front** of the shirt, and the player's name **on the back**.
sentences.translation: Jamoa logotipi futbolkaning **old tomoniga**, o'yinchining ismi esa **orqa tomoniga** bosilgan.

sentences.text: Shall we sit **at the front** of the bus, where it's less bumpy?
sentences.translation: Avtobusning **old qismida** o'tiramizmi? U yerda kamroq silkitadi.

examples.title: One place, different meanings: window, door, water
examples.description: at the window — deraza oldida, in the window — vitrinada; at the door / on the door / in the doorway; in the water / on the water; on a chair, lekin in an armchair; on the grass.

sentences.text: Aziz was standing **at the window**, watching the snow fall on the city.
sentences.translation: Aziz **deraza oldida** turib, shaharga yog'ayotgan qorni tomosha qilardi.

sentences.text: I saw a lovely blue dress **in the window** of that shop on the high street.
sentences.translation: Bosh ko'chadagi o'sha do'konning **vitrinasida** chiroyli ko'k ko'ylak ko'rdim.

sentences.text: There's a sign **on the door** saying that the office is closed for lunch.
sentences.translation: **Eshikda** ofis tushlikka yopilgani haqida yozuv osig'liq.

sentences.text: Nilufar stood **in the doorway**, too shy to come into the room.
sentences.translation: Nilufar xonaga kirishga uyalib, **ostonada** turib qoldi.

sentences.text: Two swans were floating **on the water** near the bridge.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik yonida ikki oqqush **suv ustida** suzib yurardi.

sentences.text: It was so hot that we spent the whole afternoon **in the water**.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik issiq ediki, tushdan keyingi vaqtni butunlay **suvda** o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: The doctor asked me to sit **on a hard chair** while he examined my back.
sentences.translation: Shifokor belimni tekshirayotganda meni **qattiq stulda** o'tirishimni so'radi.

sentences.text: James fell asleep **in an armchair** in front of the TV.
sentences.translation: Jeyms televizor oldidagi **kresloda** uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: In summer, students often have lunch **on the grass** outside the university library.
sentences.translation: Yozda talabalar ko'pincha universitet kutubxonasi oldidagi **maysada** tushlik qilishadi.

sentences.text: Who's that **at the door**? — It's probably the neighbour with our post.
sentences.translation: **Eshik oldida** kim? — Ehtimol, qo'shnimiz pochtamizni olib kelgandir.

examples.title: Where exactly? — **In**, **at** or **on**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: «Qayerda?» savollariga aniq javoblar — in, at va on bir misolda.

sentences.text: Where did you leave the car keys? — **On the shelf** by the front door.
sentences.translation: Mashina kalitlarini qayerda qoldirding? — Old eshik yonidagi **tokchada**.

sentences.text: Have you seen my glasses anywhere? — Yes, they're **on your head**!
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni biror joyda ko'rdingmi? — Ha, **boshingda**-ku!

sentences.text: Where's Tom? — He's waiting for us **at the entrance** to the metro.
sentences.translation: Tom qani? — U bizni metroning **kirish joyida** kutyapti.

sentences.text: Is the restaurant easy to find? — Yes, it's **on the corner**, opposite the bank.
sentences.translation: Restoranni topish osonmi? — Ha, u **muyulishda**, bankning qarshisida.

sentences.text: What happened to the flowers I bought? — They're **in the vase** on the kitchen table.
sentences.translation: Men olgan gullar nima bo'ldi? — Ular oshxona stolidagi **guldonda**.

sentences.text: Can you see Sarah? — Yes, she's sitting **at the bar**, chatting to the waiter.
sentences.translation: Sarani ko'ryapsanmi? — Ha, u **bar peshtaxtasi oldida** ofitsiant bilan gaplashib o'tiribdi.

sentences.text: Kate found her lost ring **in the pocket** of her winter coat three months later.
sentences.translation: Keyt yo'qolgan uzugini uch oydan keyin qishki paltosining **cho'ntagidan** topdi.

sentences.text: Our hotel was **on a quiet island**, an hour by boat from the coast.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonamiz qirg'oqdan qayiqda bir soatlik masofadagi **sokin orolda** edi.

sentences.text: There were three men **at the next table**, arguing loudly about football.
sentences.translation: **Qo'shni stolda** futbol haqida qattiq bahslashayotgan uchta erkak o'tirardi.

sentences.text: A notice **on the wall** in the corridor says that smoking isn't allowed **in the building**.
sentences.translation: Yo'lakdagi **devorda** osig'liq e'londa **binoda** chekish mumkin emasligi yozilgan.
